_readme: Per-day editorial picks. Hero override lives in hero-overrides.json; this file holds the line, hook, archetype and the reasoning. Chosen by hand for the dry run; Phase D automates the line pick with a cheap model and this file becomes the override layer.

09-08.line: Anyone know where I can get the ‘urban youth cliche clipart vol 7 cd’?
alternates: Advertising ‘the snip’ must be an interesting brief…
09-08.why: A question, so the dialog gets Yes/No. Every image that day is dead (Photobucket, Skitch, Posterous), so the starfield's error boxes are all true.

09-09.line: I wonder how long the others will last?
alternates: But then I don’t normally laugh out loud like a freak in the office either…
Jeez, is there nothing that can’t be turned into a video game these days
09-09.why: The post records one of its own videos being taken down. The YouTube 'no longer available' hook is the truth, and the remaining video is the payoff.

09-10.line: Anthropologists could figure out a lot about Brighton just by looking at this chippy window.
alternates: And of course there’s a small dose of Tai Chi for good measure.
Yeah, that’s what they say… I don’t think it’s strictly true though.
09-10.why: Three posts, all with local images. The grid holds the chippy photo in a cell; Internet Now Working is the search field; Everything Is Amazing is the video thumbnail.

09-11.line: I clicked on a banner today.
alternates: I probably click on 2/3 a month.
09-11.why: Twelve posts. A cascade of twelve windows is the day. The dialogs are I object to this too, I think I object, Wow.

09-12.line: This is a very big crane on Ebor Street near my work.
alternates: I got bluetoothed yesterday at Euston Station.
It made me realise just how lazy I’ve been with blogging.
09-12.why: Deadpan. The crane photo is the hero element, cropped off the top of the frame like ref 1's headline. Blogs is Back is the Notepad.

11-09.line: Bill has bullets, Steve has space.
11-09.runnerUp: Anyone know what that funny bird sound is?
alternates: And the video has aged really really badly too.
Once you realise you’re becoming a geek is there any way to reverse the process…?
11-09.why: Seven words, a whole argument, and it makes no sense without the post. The Sueño Latino video (1odEmDYg4Y4) is terminated, so its error text is the day's DV material and the Post-it Note Waterfall (480×360, 15 fps, a dim conference stage) is the camcorder footage. Three 2005 images are gone: Picture1.jpg (powerpoint logo), talkingPointMini_01.jpg (talkingpoint screengrab), hulger.jpg (hulger phone).
